prerequisites.reason: Understanding gradients requires partial derivatives, which are necessary to learn gradient descent.
Many optimization methods rely on derivatives to analyze and update parameters.
Training neural networks commonly depends on gradient-based optimization, especially gradient descent.
Training neural networks requires understanding how model parameters are optimized.
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are defined through matrix algebra, so matrix operations are necessary first.
Neural network computations and parameter updates rely heavily on matrix operations.
Training neural networks is a specific instance of the broader training process for machine learning models.
